problem:
Suppose we wish to approximate the solution to an initial value problem using the following numerical method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =(xy+{y}^{2})\cdot Δx \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy\end{aligned}
$$

If the exact solution is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)=3{x}^{2}+5x,$ find an expression for the local truncation error for the step from $x$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx.$

feedback.problem:
Suppose we wish to approximate the solution to an initial value problem using the following numerical method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =({x}^{2}+\sqrt{y})\cdot Δx \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy\end{aligned}
$$

If the exact solution is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)={x}^{2}+4x+5,$ find an expression for the local truncation error for the step from $x$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The local truncation error (LTE) is the error made in a single step of a numerical method, when the step begins from an exact value. The LTE of a numerical method at step $n$ from $x$ with exact value ${y}_{\text{exact}}$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{n} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-{y}_{\text{new}} \\  & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-({y}_{\text{exact}}(x)+Δy).\end{aligned}
$$

We're given that the exact solution of the initial value problem is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)={x}^{2}+4x+5.$ Now, let's find the $y$-increment given by the numerical method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & =({x}^{2}+\sqrt{{y}_{\text{exact}}(x)})\cdot Δx \\  & =({x}^{2}+\sqrt{{x}^{2}+4x+5})\cdot Δx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we compute the exact value at ${x}_{\text{new}}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}}) & =(x+Δx)^{2}+4(x+Δx)+5 \\  & ={x}^{2}+2x\cdot Δx+(Δx)^{2}+4x+4\cdot Δx+5 \\  & ={x}^{2}+4x+5+(2x+4)\cdot Δx+(Δx)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we calculate the LTE for step $n$ starting at $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{n} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-{y}_{\text{new}} \\  & =[{x}^{2}+4x+5+(2x+4)\cdot Δx+(Δx)^{2}]-[{x}^{2}+4x+5+({x}^{2}+\sqrt{{x}^{2}+4x+5})\cdot Δx] \\  & ={x}^{2}-{x}^{2}+4x-4x+5-5+(2x+4)\cdot Δx+(Δx)^{2}-({x}^{2}+\sqrt{{x}^{2}+4x+5})\cdot Δx \\  & =((2x+4)-{x}^{2}-\sqrt{{x}^{2}+4x+5})\cdot Δx+(Δx)^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
